jobs.description:

The position requires vigilant patrols, rapid decision-making, and strong customer service skills to assist guests and staff in various situations while upholding Zoo policies and SOPs.

jobs.title: Data Center SOC & Patrol Security Officer
jobs.description: Prosegur Security USA, Inc. is seeking a SOC / Patrol Officer in Texas. The role involves maintaining a secure data center environment, monitoring CCTV and alarms, and controlling access with proper badges. You will perform both virtual and physical patrols, respond to incidents, and document activities with DARs and logs. Qualifications include 18+ years, a High School Diploma or GED, and a valid Texas Level II Unarmed Security License. Prior SOC or security ops experience is preferred.
